主要内容: On January 7, 2016, The Walt Disney Company elected Mark G. Parker as a Director, effective immediately. Mr. Parker has been President and Chief Executive Officer and a director of NIKE, Inc. since 2006. The Board of Directors concluded that Mr. Parker could not be considered an independent director under the New York Stock Exchange's independence requirements due to his brother's relationship with the Company. Christopher Parker, Mr. Parker's brother, owns a company that provided screen writing services to Disney in connection with a film project from 2013 to 2015, receiving $350,000 in compensation. The Company has rights to further compensation if the film is produced and Mr. Parker's brother receives screen writing credit. The arrangement was reviewed and deemed consistent with the Company's best interests. The Board determined that Mr. Parker's relationship with his brother's company disqualifies him from being an independent director at this time.
